result.title: Memory-Efficient Subspace Optimization with Residual Correction: From Momentum SGD to Muon
result.summary: Memory-efficient subspace optimization has emerged as a practical approach to reducing the memory cost of LLM training while preserving optimization performance. Previous algorithms typically rely on the leading singular subspace of stochastic gradients, yet the gradient noise may dominate the subspace in later training stages and can prevent convergence. To overcome this limitation, we adopt a residual correction framework, which maintains the optimizer states in the subspace and adds the orthogonal residual gradient to the parameter update. We first integrate this scheme into momentum SGD to develop SMRC, which attains an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for a fixed orthonormal basis, matching that of full-space momentum SGD. Our analysis introduces a subspace virtual iterate to resolve the coupling between the momentum and the residual correction. Furthermore, we extend SMRC to a multi-stage variant which periodically recomputes bases to track the evolving dominant subspace and retains the same rate. Since each basis refresh breaks the consistency of the virtual iterates, we devise a boundary correction approach that aligns them across stages. Beyond momentum SGD, we incorporate our framework into Muon and propose PMRC, which applies the matrix sign to the projected momentum. Through a weighted momentum tracking analysis that accounts for the residual gradient, we establish an $O(T^{-1/4})$ convergence rate for PMRC, which matches the rate of full-space Muon. We also design a multi-stage PMRC with periodically refreshed bases, which maintains a convergence rate of the same order. Extensive experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithms.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出残差校正的子空间优化框架：把优化器状态限制在随机梯度的主子空间中，并把正交残差梯度加入参数更新，先给出 momentum SGD 版本 SMRC，再扩展到 Muon 得到 PMRC，并设计周期性刷新基的多阶段变体，理论上保持 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛率。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属 LLM 训练的显存优化，不涉及多模态推理；但其「主子空间状态 + 正交残差修正」的低维状态压缩与基刷新机制，可能为思考 latent 状态如何在低维子空间中保留任务必要信息、以及被舍弃方向是否需要补偿提供类比线索，可供核查。
